actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.

official_title: A bill to require all construction and renovation projects in Ukraine receiving funding from the United States to comply with accessibility standards that are substantively equivalent to the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, the Architectural Barriers Act of 1968, and related regulations.
